title: Growing up on South Robertson in the Garden District
summary: He describes the neighborhood he lived in until about age 22.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: What neighborhood did you grow up in?

Well, sort of up to the Garden District. And I was, I was born on South Robinson in the 1200 block. We, my family moved on the South street and I was, so they told me I was nine months old and they stayed there. I stayed there until I was about 22 years old. On the South street.
Right. In other words, that's right around with the Mardi Gras Indians and all around.
Yeah. Right. On the South between Thaya and E Radda.
